name: file_session
description: Session-scoped file workspace. Upload files, OADSON reads and rewrites them, download results. No filesystem needed — MongoDB backed.

action.description: list: show all files in session. read: get file content. write: create/overwrite a file. delete: remove one file. drop: delete all session files. summary: count and list filenames.

filename.description: File to read, write or delete.
